meta.bit_reading_note: Part A positions run Kickoff 43's XOR_5 reuse circuit on the cell's chain: its outcome is the classical bits of circuits.XOR_5.measured_clbits in k43-reuse.json, the last listed bit first; Part B: classical bit 0 is the spectator s, bit 1 is c's mid-circuit result (S only)
meta.description: Kickoff 46, the middle line. Part A: Kickoff 43's XOR_5 reuse circuit on six chains, 5 interleaved copies, 10000 shots each. Part B, Design S simplified: a spectator s in superposition waits while a neighbour c is retired (S), flipped and flipped back after a delay (S1), or left alone (S0), for 12 (s, c) combinations, each run twice in mirror order, 2000 shots each. 102 circuits, counts.
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0
